_comment: Worker safety settings for Windows (passed to every worker by start-worker.ps1 -Safety; macOS / Linux: settings.example.json). Replace C:\ABSOLUTE\PATH with the absolute path of the project's core copy, <project>\coordinator\core (the folder that holds scripts/; JSON needs \\ for each backslash). This is the SWARM and STANDARD baseline (CORE section 3): only the protected branches and irreversible removals are guarded; workers do routine risky work themselves and report it. The STRICT preset adds "Bash(gh pr merge*)", "Bash(gh pr ready*)" and the production MCP write tools; the CAUTIOUS override also adds "Read(**/.env*)" and the stack candidates chosen in the init quiz (examples/nextjs-supabase/settings.json). Also add gh pr merge / ready denies wherever PROJECT.md says humans merge or mark ready. MCP tools bypass the hook (it sees only shell tools), so their writes are denied here: the names assume the GitHub MCP server is connected as "github" (mcp__<server>__<tool>) - rename them to the server name this machine uses, and add the write tools of any other connected server that can change a protected branch. Drop mcp__github__merge_pull_request only where workers merge their own PRs (PROJECT.md). attribution hides the AI co-author trailer, the PR line and the session link: artifacts are in the owner's voice (CORE section 11).
